header.running_head: The Importance Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) Gave to the Adhaan

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) once said, "Had I been a Mu'adhin, I care not if I neither perform Hajj or Umrah except for the Fardh Hajj. Had the angels descended on earth, none would be able to beat them to calling out the Adhaan (they would allow no one else to do it because they know its tremendous virtue)." [^1]

Hadhrat Qais bin Abu Haazim narrates that when they went to Hadhrat Umar (RA), he asked, "Who calls out the Adhaan amongst you people?" When they informed him that it was their slaves who did it, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "That is a grave deficiency in you. Had I the choice of being a Mu'adhin instead of the Khalifah, I would have chosen to be a Mu'adhin." [^2]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "I regret not requesting Rasulullaah ﷺ to assign the duty of calling out the Adhaan to (my sons) Hasan and Husayn." [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "I do not approve of you appointing blind people to call out the Adhaan (because they are unable to determine the correct times of salaah) and I also do not approve of you appointing learned scholars of the Qur'aan to call out the Adhaan (because this would affect their teaching)." [^4]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)'s Words to a man who Adopted a Singing Tone when Calling out the Adhaan and took Payment for it

Hadhrat Yahya Bakkaa narrates that a man once said to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), "I love you for the sake of Allaah." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) responded by saying, "But I detest you for the sake of Allaah." When the man asked why this was, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "Because you adopt a singing tone when calling out the Adhaan and you take payment for it." [^5]
Rasulullaah ﷺ and Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Instruct that Jihaad be Waged Against Tribes amongst whom the Adhaan is not called out

When Rasulullaah ﷺ dispatched Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas (RA) to Yemen, he gave him instructions to take as prisoners the inhabitants of all the towns he passed in which the Adhaan was not called out. Therefore, when Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) passed by the Banu Zubayd tribe and did not hear them call out the Adhaan, he took them all as prisoners. However, when Hadhrat Amr bin Ma'dikarib (RA) spoke to him about them, Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) released them into his custody. [^6]
